Question: What is the average policy size which is the the total amount of premium divided by the number of policies?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    CAST(SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS decimal(18,2)) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.Policy_Identifier), 0) AS average_policy_size
FROM Policy p
JOIN Policy_Amount pa
    ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Premium pr
    ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier;

What are the total loss, which is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by claim number and corresponding policy number, policy holder and premium amount paid?

SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    p.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    ph.policy_holder,
    COALESCE(prm.premium_amount_paid, 0) AS premium_amount_paid,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS loss_payment_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS loss_reserve_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expense_payment_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expense_reserve_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE 
        WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount
        WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount
        WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount
        WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount
        ELSE 0
    END), 0) AS total_loss
FROM Claim c
LEFT JOIN Claim_Amount ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
    ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
    ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
    ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
   AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
        MAX(CAST(pt.Party_Identifier AS varchar(50))) AS policy_holder
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
    JOIN Party pt
        ON pt.Party_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
    WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'POLICYHOLDER'
    GROUP BY apr.Agreement_Identifier
) ph
    ON ph.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount_paid
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    JOIN Premium pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
) prm
    ON prm.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    p.Policy_Number,
    ph.policy_holder,
    prm.premium_amount_paid
ORDER BY
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    p.Policy_Number;

What is the total amount of premiums that a policy holder has paid by policy number?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    apr.Party_Identifier AS Policy_Holder_Identifier,
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Total_Premiums_Paid
FROM Premium pr
JOIN Policy_Amount pa
    ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pa.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Agreement_Party_Role apr
    ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'POLICY_HOLDER'
GROUP BY
    p.Policy_Number,
    apr.Party_Identifier;

What are the loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by claim number and corresponding policy number, policy holder, premium amount paid, the catastrophe it had, and the agent who sold it?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    p.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    ph.party_holder_name AS policy_holder,
    COALESCE(lp.loss_payment_amount, 0) AS loss_payment_amount,
    COALESCE(lr.loss_reserve_amount, 0) AS loss_reserve_amount,
    COALESCE(ep.expense_payment_amount, 0) AS expense_payment_amount,
    COALESCE(er.expense_reserve_amount, 0) AS expense_reserve_amount,
    COALESCE(pr.premium_amount_paid, 0) AS premium_amount_paid,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name AS catastrophe_name,
    ag.party_agent_name AS agent_who_sold_it
FROM Claim c
LEFT JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
   AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Catastrophe cat
    ON cat.Catastrophe_Identifier = c.Catastrophe_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS loss_payment_amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    INNER JOIN Loss_Payment lp
        ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
) lp
    ON lp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS loss_reserve_amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    INNER JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
        ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
) lr
    ON lr.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS expense_payment_amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    INNER JOIN Expense_Payment ep
        ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
) ep
    ON ep.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS expense_reserve_amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    INNER JOIN Expense_Reserve er
        ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
) er
    ON er.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount_paid
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    INNER JOIN Premium pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
) pr
    ON pr.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier,
        CAST(apr.Party_Identifier AS varchar(100)) AS party_holder_name
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
    WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'POLICYHOLDER'
) ph
    ON ph.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier,
        CAST(apr.Party_Identifier AS varchar(100)) AS party_agent_name
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
    WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AGENT'
) ag
    ON ag.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number, p.Policy_Number;

Question: What are the loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by claim number and corresponding policy number, policy holder, premium amount paid, the catastrophe it had, and the agent who sold it?
Return agents and the policy they have sold that have had a claim and the corresponding expense reserve amount by agent id, policy number and claim number
Generated Query:
SELECT
    apr.Party_Identifier AS agent_id,
    p.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS expense_reserve_amount
FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier IS NOT NULL
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
   AND pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
   AND pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Claim c
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Amount ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Expense_Reserve er
    ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AGENT'
GROUP BY
    apr.Party_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number,
    c.Company_Claim_Number
ORDER BY
    apr.Party_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number,
    c.Company_Claim_Number;
